matches.label: exact
matches.reason: Both identify inadequately scrutinized, potentially time-varying disease reporting rates as a source of bias in the epidemiological estimates.

matches.label: related_but_distinct

matches.reason: Both argue that the cross-sectional reduced-form intensity measure is not cleanly comparable to the epidemiological cohort-timing measure and may confound cohort-specific differences.

matches.label: partial
matches.reason: Both question whether mortality-based reduced-form exposure validly represents the disease environment relevant to surviving children, though B5 states the proxy assumption more narrowly.

matches.label: partial
